sources.entry: Icinga | Monitoring system for IT infrastructure

summary.one_liner: Icinga 2 is a monitoring server that checks the availability of network resources, notifies users of outages, and generates performance data for reporting.
summary.what_it_does: Icinga 2 runs checks against network resources and reports whether they are available, alerting users when outages occur. It also produces performance data that can be used for reporting. The README describes it as scalable and extensible, able to monitor large, complex environments across multiple locations. Configuration can be managed through the Icinga Director, config management tools, or plain text files written in the Icinga DSL. The README states that Icinga 2 requires Icinga Web 2 on top as part of the wider Icinga Stack. It also mentions distributed monitoring and a set of modules and integrations.
use_cases: manage monitoring configuration with a DSL or config management tools
how_to_run: Follow the Installation chapter in the Icinga documentation at icinga.com/docs
Install Icinga Web 2 on top to form the Icinga Stack
Optionally manage configuration with the Icinga Director
notable: Configuration via Icinga DSL, Icinga Director, or config management tools
Distributed monitoring support for multi-site setups
Part of the Icinga Stack with Icinga Web 2 as the UI
